profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Adobe
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with a masters degree in computer science. Having experience developing in Linux and Windows environments. Experience with modeling and simulation, working with and creating databases, writing database APIs, system integration and testing, developing web pages with ASP.NET framework, test driven development, architecting IP networks, interfacing with customers, providing demonstrations and presentations to management and customers, participating in peer reviews and promoting a positive work environment.
